reviewer_notes: Death rows were visually inspected through the corrected contact sheet and exported previews.
The animation reads as a non-looping collapse from standing or staggered pose to final still body, with no gore.

West and south-west rows use frame-order-preserving mirrored derivatives from successful imagegen rows; north-east and north-west use back-view fallbacks derived from the successful north row because repeated direct generation returned no image result.
The crimson caster identity, robe, dark shoulder plates, and ruby staff remain readable across all rows.
